incidents.title: A repaired failed criterion remained failed instead of becoming affected for full-chain reverification
incidents.rootCause: Verification invalidation only selected passed and manual statuses, excluding the failed criterion that triggered repair
incidents.invariant: After a repair, every non-deferred acceptance result must become affected before reverification

incidents.title: A copied Skill CLI could exit silently when macOS exposed the same temporary path through /var and /private/var aliases
incidents.rootCause: Direct execution detection compared unresolved URL strings instead of canonical filesystem paths
incidents.invariant: CLI self-execution detection must compare canonical real filesystem paths
